correctness.rationale: Differentiating the displayed Hamiltonian with respect to S gives lambda1[(1-u2)theta E+(mu+z0 u1)]-lambda2(1-u2)theta E. The printed equation adds -lambda2(mu+z0 u1). The terminal conditions and positive disease-cost weight force lambda2(T-tau)=alpha C3 tau^2/2+O(tau^3), so the discrepancy is genuinely active near the terminal point. The bundled symbolic checker reproduces all state gradients exactly.
